prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 91.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 74.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 36.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Auth Reorder After Adoption: Reorder the sign_in step to occur right after adoption_certificate instead of before adoption, letting users choose and name their pet first. (why: Adoption has a 73.1% conversion rate; allowing users to customize their pet before sign-in increases motivation to complete authentication.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Personality Temperament Calibration Screen: Insert a new screen called new_personality_calibration between pick_friend and upload_photos to set pet behavioral traits. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pets looking or behaving unexpectedly, and adoption has a drop-off of nearly 27%.)
2: [home, wait_info] Spawntime Ready Sound Chime Notification: Add sound chime alert and taskbar docking status text to the waiting screen when desktop spawning completes. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing up on desktop or app not launching after wait step; median waiting time is 201s.)
3: [finish, incentive] First Desktop Interaction Achievement Badge: Offer an unlockable achievement badge on the home_intro screen for completing the first pet interaction on desktop. (why: Finish conversion drops to 74.8% with a long mean duration of 5815s; clear rewards drive immediate engagement.)
4: [choose_path, hint] Companion Path Selection Recommendation Hint: Add a recommendation tip carousel on choose_path matching app playstyles with system CPU usage. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s, indicating user confusion or indecision between options.)
